name: [Illustration] Alchemical Emblem
nl: Emblem-book print, engraved symbolic diagram enclosed in a ruled roundel, celestial and mineral signs arranged in strict hierarchy, dense burin hatching, laid paper with plate tone, print style image,

name: [Illustration] Marginalia Grotesque
nl: Manuscript-margin drawing, spindly hybrid creatures sprouting from inked vine tendrils, gold leaf dots, tiny burnished initials, ruled text block left blank beside them, vellum tone, drawing style image,

name: [Illustration] Blackwork Dotwork Tattoo
nl: Blackwork drawing, solid black masses beside dense stippled gradients, geometric ornament and sacred-geometry framing, no colour whatsoever, bare skin tone left as the highlight, drawing style image,

name: [Illustration] Airbrushed Van Mural
nl: Custom-van illustration, airbrushed fantasy scene on sheet metal, soft candy gradients and chrome highlight sparkle, wraparound composition following the panel curve, clear-coat gloss, illustration style image,
negative: hard inked outlines, matte flat colour

name: [Illustration] Pinstripe Kustom
nl: Pinstripe illustration, long tapering sword-brush lines in symmetrical pairs, gold and white scrollwork over deep gloss lacquer, hairline flourishes ending in fine points, illustration style image,

name: [Drawing] Chicano Fine-Line
nl: Fine-line drawing, single-needle grey wash and pencil, smooth photoreal graduation in monochrome, script lettering and ornate framing, deep blacks against bare paper, drawing style image,
negative: flat colour fills, loose sketchy line

name: [Experimental] Ferrofluid Spikes
nl: Ferrofluid work, oily black liquid pulled into ordered spikes by a magnetic field, mirror-wet surface, sharp specular points along every peak, sterile studio reflection behind, material style image,

name: [Experimental] Pyrography Wood Burn
nl: Pyrography work, scorched line burned into pale timber, tone built by dwell time from honey to charcoal, singed halo at the edges, grain deflecting every stroke, material style image,

name: [Experimental] Papier-Mâché Folk Figure
nl: Papier-mâché, pulped paper forms with visible seams and lumps, matte poster colour in clashing bright patterns, dotted and striped decoration, uneven hand-finished edges, handmade style image,

name: [Experimental] Scrimshaw
nl: Scrimshaw work, fine incisions scratched into polished bone and rubbed with ink, tone made of hatch density alone, warm cream ground with age crazing, shallow surface sheen, material style image,

name: [Experimental] Coffee Wash
nl: Coffee-wash work, tannin-stained tonal washes on absorbent paper, hard tide lines at every dried edge, ring marks and granular sediment, warm sepia range only, material style image,
negative: bright saturated pigment, flat digital fills

name: [Experimental] Street Chalk Anamorphic
nl: Pavement-chalk drawing, soft pastel dust worked into rough paving, deliberate anamorphic stretch across the slabs, joint lines cutting through the drawing, dusty bloom over the whole surface, material style image,

name: [Experimental] Kirigami Pop-Up
nl: Kirigami, card cut and folded into upright layers, crisp scored creases and hard cast shadows between planes, white stock with one accent colour, depth built from stepped tiers, handmade style image,

name: [Experimental] Nail and Thread String Art
nl: String-art, coloured thread strung between panel pins, straight chords massing into curved moiré envelopes, thread crossings darkening the overlaps, stained board behind, handmade style image,

name: [Experimental] Rangoli Powder
nl: Rangoli work, coloured powder poured into symmetrical floor patterns, radial geometry with soft grainy borders, saturated pigment mounds catching side light, swept stone beneath, material style image,

name: [Experimental] Anthotype Plant Emulsion
nl: Anthotype work, crushed petal juice coated on paper and bleached by weeks of sun, pale magenta or spinach-green monochrome, soft undefined edges, uneven brush-coated border, material style image,

name: [Experimental] Rust Transfer
nl: Rust-transfer work, oxidised iron printed onto damp cloth, orange-brown bloom spreading along the weave, hard object silhouettes where metal lay, salt speckle and tide edges, material style image,
negative: clean printed graphics, vivid ink colour

name: [Experimental] Cymatic Plate
nl: Cymatic rendering, fine sand gathered into nodal figures on a vibrating plate, symmetrical geometric lattices with soft mounded ridges, dark metal ground, raking light picking out the relief, material style image,

name: [Experimental] Petri Dish Culture
nl: Culture-plate work, colonies spreading across nutrient agar in concentric fringed rings, translucent gel catching light from below, velvety and glossy patches side by side, glass rim shadow, material style image,

name: [Experimental] Hydro-Dip Transfer
nl: Hydro-dip work, a printed film floated on water and wrapped around a solid form, pattern stretching and pooling over every curve, seams meeting out of register, glossy clear coat over it, material style image,
negative: flat decal application, matte untreated surface
